Piper Diagram

Source: R/plotting.R
piper_plot.Rd

Creates a Piper diagram for hydrochemical facies interpretation using major-ion chemistry data.

Usage

piper_plot(df, ...)

# S3 method for class 'data.frame'
piper_plot(df, location, analyte, result, unit, date, ...)

# S3 method for class 'env_schema'
piper_plot(
  df,
  analyte_matching = c("strict", "exact", "normalized"),
  x_cation = "Calcium, dissolved",
  x_cation_label = "Ca",
  y_cation = "Magnesium, dissolved",
  y_cation_label = "Mg",
  z_cation = c("Sodium, dissolved", "Potassium, dissolved"),
  z_cation_label = "Na + K",
  x_anion = c("Chloride, total", "Fluoride, total"),
  x_anion_label = "Cl + F",
  y_anion = "Alkalinity, total (lab)",
  y_anion_label = "HCO[3] + CO[3]",
  z_anion = "Sulfate, total",
  z_anion_label = "SO4",
  x_z_anion_label = "SO4 + Cl + F",
  x_y_cation_label = "Ca + Mg",
  scale_analyte = NULL,
  group_col = NULL,
  transparency = 0.7,
  pnt_size = 3,
  label_size = 3,
  title = NULL
)

Arguments

df

A data frame or `env_schema` object.

...

Additional arguments passed to methods.

location

Location identifier column.

analyte

Analyte column.

result

Analytical result column.

unit

Reporting unit column.

date

Sample date column.

analyte_matching

Analyte matching strategy used to resolve analyte names. One of `"exact"`, `"strict"`, or `"normalized"`.

x_cation

Character vector identifying analytes representing calcium.

x_cation_label

Label for the calcium axis.

y_cation

Character vector identifying analytes representing magnesium.

y_cation_label

Label for the magnesium axis.

z_cation

Character vector identifying analytes representing sodium and potassium.

z_cation_label

Label for the sodium plus potassium axis.

x_anion

Character vector identifying analytes representing chloride and fluoride.

x_anion_label

Label for the chloride plus fluoride axis.

y_anion

Character vector identifying analytes representing alkalinity.

y_anion_label

Label for the bicarbonate/carbonate axis.

z_anion

Character vector identifying analytes representing sulfate.

z_anion_label

Label for the sulfate axis.

x_z_anion_label

Label displayed on the upper-left side of the Piper diamond.

x_y_cation_label

Label displayed on the upper-right side of the Piper diamond.

scale_analyte

Optional analyte used to scale point size.

group_col

Optional column used to assign point shape.

transparency

Point transparency.

pnt_size

Point size when size scaling is not used.

label_size

Axis label size.

title

Optional plot title.

Value

A ggplot object containing a Piper diagram.

Details

`piper_plot()` is an S3 generic that supports both raw data frames and `env_schema` objects.

For data frames, environmental column mappings must be supplied. For `env_schema` objects, mapped schema fields are used automatically.

For data frames, `piper_plot()` first converts the supplied data to an `env_schema` object using the specified column mappings and then dispatches to [piper_plot.env_schema()].

Piper diagrams display normalized major-ion chemistry within cation and anion ternary plots and a central hydrochemical facies diamond.

Major ions are converted to milliequivalents per liter (meq/L), normalized to ionic percentages, and transformed into Piper coordinates before plotting.

For `env_schema` objects, analyte, result, unit, date, and location fields are obtained directly from schema mappings.

Analyte Matching

exact

Uses analyte names exactly as reported.

strict

Applies text normalization while preserving analytical distinctions such as dissolved versus total fractions.

normalized

Resolves analyte aliases to canonical analyte names using package analyte metadata.

Validation

Input data are validated for:

  • required major ions;

  • analyte resolution;

  • supported analytical units;

  • duplicate analyte measurements;

  • completeness of major-ion chemistry.

data(gw)

piper_plot(gw)
